senses.gloss: ch. same, also the camel’s ring or staff through the nose and the basket fastened thereto.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 37:29">Targ. Is. XXXVII, 29</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 32:9">Targ. Ps. XXXII, 9</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 111b">Ib. 111ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>קיטרא דקטרי בז׳</he> the loop which is made to fasten the camel’s basket to the ring; <he>קיטרא דז׳ גופיה</he> the (permanent) knot in the bit itself; v. <cite ref="A01460"><he>אִיסְטְרִידָא</he></cite>.
